name: Spark Connector for Fabric Data Warehouse - General Availability
description: The Spark connector for Microsoft Fabric Data Warehouse enables Spark developers and data scientists to access and work with data from a warehouse and the SQL analytics endpoint of a lakehouse. It offers a simplified Spark API, abstracts underlying complexity, and operates with just one line of code, while upholding security models like object-level security (OLS), row-level security (RLS), and column-level security (CLS).
